dialogues.speaker: "Muchih"
dialogues.text: An easy-breezy Natlan in an easy-breezy summer! Welcome to Villa... Uhm, whoops, I mean, welcome to Wavey Bay! This place is... Uhh, what were my lines again...?

dialogues.speaker: "Muchih"
dialogues.text: Ah, yeah! This place is home to a natural sandy beach formed by five hundred years of ocean currents! It's also... Uhh...
